title.en: Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) Order 2025

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Housing and Development (Precincts for Upgrading Works) (Home Improvement Programme) Order 2025 and comes into operation on 8 January 2025.

heading.en: Declaration of precinct for Home Improvement Programme

text.en: 2. The part of the housing estate of the Board described in the Schedule is declared to be a precinct for the purposes of carrying out upgrading works in connection with the Home Improvement Programme.

THE SCHEDULE
All that part of the housing estate of the Board bounded by Queensway Flyover, Queen’s Close, Mei Chin Road, Mei Ling Street and Stirling Road, comprised in Lot number 04755V in Mukim 03 and on which Apartment Blocks 19, 20, 21 and 22 are erected, in Lot number 02795W in Mukim 03 and on which Apartment Blocks 143, 145 and 146 are erected, and in Lot number 02792L in Mukim 03 and on which Apartment Blocks 147, 148, 149 and 150 are erected, which blocks are each marked with a grey dot in the Plan.
